description: ODC: a complete Semantic Search node (tested coverage, phase 2). SearchAttributes is a read-only collection that the platform changes through AddSearchableAttributes/RemoveSearchableAttributes; without a path through the verbs the node always stayed with the error SemanticSearch_RequiredSearchAttributes. The `set SearchAttributes` takes the whole list, like Roles: each item is the `AsSearchable` of an attribute marked IsSearchable. The second set swaps the list (Remove + Add) and the final get reads it back.

expectedMessages.why: ODC: an app (CrossDevice) does not expose a public server action (the live Studio gives an error); the action stays private and without a consumer in this proof job
